title: AlertEventDocument
description: MongoDB `alert_events` collection document — one per alert evaluation, whether or not it was actually sent. Index on (subscription_id, created_at) for dedup lookups. §70, §99.7. alert_type and channel enums kept identical to api/AlertSubscriptionRequest.json. 'level' here is intentionally the full 4-value risk scale (a SAFE evaluation is still logged for audit), unlike AlertSubscriptionRequest's minimum_level which is only 3-value (CAUTION/UNSAFE/DANGEROUS) since you can't subscribe to be alerted at SAFE — different concepts, not a mismatch.

analysis_id.description: The alert_check analysis that produced this evaluation. §70.1

level.description: The evaluated risk level at check time — full scale, not just the subscription's alerting threshold.

previous_level.description: Compared against level to decide whether this is a resend-worthy increase. §70.4

status.description: Dedup/delivery outcome. §70.4, §66.3-style dedup logic applied to alerts.
